Axiom: Unless the operator explicitly said POC / MVP / prototype, the default depth of work targets public release: error handling, edge cases, accessibility, and loading/empty states are part of the work, not "later". Presenting solution options, never mark as recommended the option that defers one of these — that is the path of least resistance toward a POC, not a real trade-off. Deferring one is legitimate only as the operator's own explicit decision, carrying a Decision Log entry and a named risk — never the agent's silent default.
